summary: Pro tier deep decompilation, liquidity drain stress-testing, and privileged access audit for Gnosis Safe L2.

findings.title: EIP-712 Signature Malleability & Nonce Replay Prevention
findings.description: Safe transaction hashes must enforce strict EIP-712 domain separation including chainId to prevent cross-rollup replay.

attackSurface.attackVector: Attempting to replay valid Ethereum Mainnet signature on Arbitrum or Optimism without domain separator binding.

remediation.recommendedAction: Apply verified check-effects-interactions, enforce timelocks, and guard critical state variables.
